items.Canonical responsibility: Non-semantic society startup/coordinator; generic sampler remains separate
items.World: real historical evolution: No historical meaning; sampled fields are only initial state
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Coordinate coupled society refinements; no combined Population/BuiltUp/Standing weighting
items.Reason / decisions: Captured society data initializes each child. The selected society owners differentiate households and land across samples.

items.Canonical responsibility: City household placement belongs to human.land.gather.
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Regional settlement catchments develop before City household placement uses finer travel, housing and work opportunities.
items.Reason / decisions: Refinement uses the captured population without another decade of migration.

items.World: real historical evolution: Actual wealth-funded repair, neglect, weather, ecological or magical damage
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Differentiated current usable/ruined standing stock without elapsed years
items.Reason / decisions: One process across World/Region/City/Street; no duplicate maintenance simulator

items.Canonical responsibility: Movement, concentration and population spatial organization
items.World: real historical evolution: Movement/migration with elapsed time, changed census and worn routes
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Place captured residents and identity groups across reachable developed catchments using food, housing, trade and terrain. During City refinement, prior roads and usable crossings change the next round of placement.
items.Reason / decisions: Connected households may settle across captured cell boundaries. A recorded settlement census describes residents to locate in its catchment.

items.World: real historical evolution: Evolve markets, routes, capital and traded goods with real history
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Competing trade centers and corridors create construction investment and settlement pull
items.Reason / decisions: Not a static 'market intensity' field or canned city-center feature

items.Canonical responsibility: Crops, herds, food production and provisioning
items.World: real historical evolution: Agricultural change, food production and historic famine through time
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Differentiate rural land uses and incoming food access without reliving harvests or starvation
items.Reason / decisions: Dense cities can be supplied beyond the child footprint

items.Canonical responsibility: Construction, built coverage, intensification and reuse
items.World: real historical evolution: Funded development, maintenance decisions and abandonment of built land
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: BuiltUp and Standing rearranged by pressure, trade, land competition and exposure into farmsteads–dense urban form
items.Reason / decisions: No fixed population→BuiltUp, no required physical building footprints

items.World: real historical evolution: Actual population growth, disease, sustained famine or mortality over years
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Pressure/viability provider or no-op; never births/deaths to resolve finer cells
items.Reason / decisions: Do not use food or local capacity as instant population cap

items.World: real historical evolution: New storm, flood, impact and magical changes cause genuine damage
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Fine terrain differentiates present exposure and protection, without replaying a disaster
items.Reason / decisions: Provides causes to built condition and displacement via existing writer

items.Canonical responsibility: Interpret emergent settlement and retain identity/history
items.World: real historical evolution: Recognizes settlement formation during real eras
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Recognize developed areas AFTER coupled numeric differentiation, match names and rough census
items.Reason / decisions: Do not use invented World-level point center as refinement control

items.World: real historical evolution: Not an independent World demographic process
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Regional households resolve on shared society fields. City passes additionally feed road access, reservations and crossing links into placement.
items.Reason / decisions: The dedicated town-coupling adapter remains deferred. Feedback runs through the existing City and society owners.

items.World: real historical evolution: Broader numeric land scarcity already influences construction and settlement
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Region capacity/crowding competition under land.harden; no parcels
items.Reason / decisions: Do not multiply physical processes to invent regional land plots

items.Disposition: Keep at City and Street fidelity
items.Canonical responsibility: City land-use fabric and Street premises
items.World: real historical evolution: World/Region construction already has numerical built-land owner
items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Regional society resolves developed stock. City construction uses that stock, district programs, access and claims to form mixed-use ground.
items.Reason / decisions: City leaves the local street network and individual buildings to the finer map.

items.Region: emergent spatial refinement: Different spatial-refinement coordinator, not fictitious elapsed years
